description: GISTDA Open Data is a data repository run by Geo-Informatics and Space Technology Development Agency (GISTDA), Thailand. The portal offers satellite-derived and geospatial data sets of GISTDA, including flood and drought extent, burnt area and land-use layers, as downloads and web services. Coverage: Thailand. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as geotiff, shp, wms; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("ยินดีต้อนรับ - GISTDA Open Data") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support flood and drought exposure studies of Thai infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
